# Dough-Vinci Pizza & Burger

> Real Pizza. Real Smash Burger. Made with Passion. A halal pizza, smashburger and pasta restaurant coming to Richmond, BC.

This site is a preview. The menu, prices, calories and allergens, the phone number, the exact opening day, the delivery-app links and the food photos (stock images) shown on it are samples until the restaurant confirms them. Do not quote them as facts.

Opening: planned for early December 2026; the exact day is not set yet.

- Location: 12420 No. 1 Road, Richmond, BC V7E 6N2
- Parking: Free customer parking inside the building, on the ground floor.
- Hours (Pacific time): Mon–Sat 11 am–10 pm; Sun 12 pm–8 pm
- Email: info@dough-vinci.com
- Halal: All our meat is halal. Halal certification by the BC Muslim Association (BCMA).
- Service: eat in (the restaurant has seating), pickup and delivery.
- Ordering: Uber Eats, DoorDash, SkipTheDishes, Fantuan. No payment on this site.

## Pages

- [Menu](https://rajool.github.io/dough-vinci/menu/): every dish with price, calories, ingredients and allergens
- [About Us](https://rajool.github.io/dough-vinci/about/): the owner's welcome and the idea behind the name
- [Contact](https://rajool.github.io/dough-vinci/contact/): location, parking, hours, phone, halal statement, FAQ
- [Allergens & nutrition](https://rajool.github.io/dough-vinci/allergens/): every dish by allergen with calories
- [Photo credits](https://rajool.github.io/dough-vinci/credits/): the stock photos and the drawing, with their sources

The menu has three kinds of food: pizza, smashburgers and pasta, with sides, desserts and drinks. Its dishes are samples until the restaurant confirms them.
